source_raw_tex:
\eqalign{\mu(\bigcup_{J\in\Cal J_0}f^*(J))
&=\sum_{J\in\Cal J_0}\mu f^*(J)
\le q\sum_{J\in\Cal J_0}\mu J
=q\mu(\bigcup\Cal J_0)\cr
&\le q\mu(\bigcup\Cal J)
\le q\mu G
\le q(\gamma+\epsilon).\cr}
